verses.text: "People say, 'If a man divorces his wife, and she leaves him and marries another man, should he go back to her again?' Would that not make the land completely unclean? But you have lived like a prostitute with many lovers. Yet come back to me," says the LORD.

"Look up at the bare hilltops and see. Is there any place where you have not slept with your lovers? You sat by the roadside waiting for them, like a nomad in the desert. You have made the land unclean with your prostitution and your wickedness.
That is why the showers have been held back and the spring rains have not come. Yet you have the bold face of a prostitute. You refuse to be ashamed.
Have you not just now called to me, 'My Father, you have been my friend since I was young!
Will you always be angry? Will you stay angry forever?' That is what you say, but you do all the evil you can."

During the time King Josiah ruled, the LORD said to me, "Have you seen what unfaithful Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every green tree, and lived like a prostitute there.
I thought that after she had done all this, she would come back to me. But she did not come back, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.
I gave unfaithful Israel her certificate of divorce and sent her away because of all her adultery. Yet her unfaithful sister Judah was not afraid. She also went and lived like a prostitute.
Israel did not take her prostitution seriously, so she made the land unclean by committing adultery with idols of stone and wood.
In spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not come back to me with all her heart. She only pretended," says the LORD.
The LORD said to me, "Unfaithful Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.

Go and announce this message toward the north: 'Come back, unfaithful Israel,' says the LORD. 'I will no longer look at you in anger, for I am merciful,' says the LORD. 'I will not stay angry forever.
Only admit your guilt, that you have rebelled against the LORD your God. You have given your love to foreign gods under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,' says the LORD.
Come back, unfaithful children," says the LORD, "for I am your husband. I will choose you, one from a town and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
Then I will give you shepherds who follow my heart, who will lead you with knowledge and understanding.

In those days, when your numbers have greatly increased in the land," says the LORD, "people will no longer talk about 'the ark of the covenant of the LORD.' It will never come to mind. They will not remember it or miss it, and another one will not be made.
At that time Jerusalem will be called the Throne of the LORD, and all the nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD. They will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
In those days the people of Judah will join the people of Israel. Together they will come from the land of the north to the land I gave your ancestors as an inheritance.

I said to myself, 'How gladly I would treat you like my children and give you a pleasant land, the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.' I thought you would call me 'My Father' and not turn away from following me.
But like an unfaithful wife who leaves her husband, you have been unfaithful to me, people of Israel," says the LORD.
A cry is heard on the bare hilltops, the weeping and pleading of the people of Israel. For they have chosen a crooked path and have forgotten the LORD their God.
"Come back, unfaithful children, and I will heal you of your unfaithfulness." "Yes, we are coming to you, for you are the LORD our God.
Surely the noisy worship on the hills and the mountains is a lie. Surely the salvation of Israel is found in the LORD our God.
From the time we were young, shameful idols have eaten up everything our ancestors worked for, their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.

Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us. For we have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our ancestors. From our youth until today we have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God."
